selection.reason: The integrated rear position, stop and reversing lamps fall within its consolidated scope and must meet the applicable photometric, colour, construction and marking requirements.
The integrated passive retro-reflector must meet the applicable retro-reflective performance, colour, durability and marking requirements.
Installation on an M1 passenger car must satisfy the applicable number, positioning, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical-operation requirements for the lamps and retro-reflector.

The electrically operated LED/PCB assembly falls within the electromagnetic-compatibility framework for vehicle electrical/electronic subassemblies, with applicable emissions and immunity requirements.
The exposed lens, housing and mounting interfaces must respect applicable external-projection requirements when fitted to the M1 vehicle.

The rear lamp's design and integration contribute to meeting the requirement that lighting and signalling devices remain operational and visible after the prescribed low-speed protective-device impacts.

verworfen (nur Fahrzeugebene): The integrated stop lamp requires a vehicle-side braking interface consistent with the regulation's stop-lamp signal-generation requirements, which concern the braking system rather than lamp photometric approval.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): This applies conditionally if the assembly uses standardised LED light sources covered by Annex 1, rather than only lamp-specific LED modules assessed under UN R148.
Its rear position and stop-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its reversing-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its retro-reflector provisions are consolidated into UN R150, which is selected instead.
Its scope expressly excludes glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices, so the PMMA outer lens is not safety glazing under this regulation.
The specified assembly has no headlamp, front fog-lamp, cornering-lamp or adaptive front-lighting function; its reversing lamp is covered by UN R148.

drawing.product: Exploded view of a rear lamp assembly combining signalling lights, an outer lens, and a passive retro-reflector.
drawing.vehicle_location: Exterior rear of a vehicle. The drawing does not establish the vehicle side or exact body mounting position.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Covers the optical assembly and transmits outgoing light.
parts.technology: Light-transmitting molded cover, likely optical plastic; annotated as red.
parts.evidence: The foremost component is a tapered, rounded cover with a perimeter lip, transparency-style diagonal lines, and a small outlined region near one end. It is explicitly labeled 'Outer lens'.

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Provides passive conspicuity by returning incident light toward its source.
parts.technology: Patterned retro-reflective optical insert; the precise prism geometry and material are not shown.
parts.evidence: A small, separately drawn rectangular insert with repeated vertical divisions is labeled 'Retro-reflector' and aligned with the small outlined region of the outer lens.

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals the joint around the lamp perimeter against water ingress.
parts.technology: Continuous compliant perimeter seal; exact elastomer is unspecified.
parts.evidence: A separate open-center frame follows the outer lens contour between the lens and internal optical assembly and is labeled 'Seal / gasket'.

parts.name: Reflector / optical carrier
parts.function: Shapes and directs light from the sources toward the outer lens.
parts.technology: Multi-cell optical component, likely molded with reflective surfaces; coating and substrate are not established.
parts.evidence: The labeled reflector panel contains rows of oval optical cavities, an upper row of circular features, a long narrow upper section, and distinct rectangular sections at the right.

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Generate light for the lamp's active signalling functions.
parts.technology: LED array mounted on a printed circuit board.
parts.evidence: A separate elongated board behind the reflector carries repeated small square packages, additional rectangular features, and a larger outlined feature near its right end. It is explicitly labeled 'LED modules on PCB'.

parts.name: Rear position lamp
parts.function: Signals the vehicle's presence from the rear.
parts.technology: LED-based lighting using the source board and associated reflector optics.
parts.evidence: The reflector annotation identifies a rear position lamp function. Multiple optical cells and the LED board are shown, but the exact cells assigned to this function are not delineated.

parts.name: Stop lamp
parts.evidence: The LED-board annotation explicitly identifies the stop lamp function; no separate stop-lamp subassembly is isolated.

parts.name: Reversing lamp
parts.function: Provides rearward illumination and indication during reversing.
parts.technology: Integrated lighting section; its specific source and optical arrangement are not separately identified.
parts.evidence: The drawing explicitly mentions the reversing lamp, and distinct right-hand optical and board regions are visible, although their assignment to reversing is not established.

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Supports and encloses the internal components and provides assembly attachment points.
parts.technology: Tray-like housing, likely molded plastic; exact material is unspecified.
parts.evidence: The rear component has a recessed interior, raised perimeter flange, sidewall depth, and several circular attachment features. It is labeled 'Housing'.

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Secure the assembly components and maintain their relative alignment.
parts.technology: Three separate screw-like fasteners; material and thread details are not shown.
parts.evidence: Three headed, shank-like items are drawn outside the housing along assembly lines, with a 'Fasteners / clips' callout.

uncertainties: Exact dimensions, vehicle fitment, mounting side, and body attachment interfaces are not supplied.
The allocation of individual LEDs and optical cells to rear position, stop, and reversing functions cannot be determined.
The small outlined lens region may serve a separate optical function, but its color and relationship to the reversing lamp are not established.
Exact polymers, reflector coatings, gasket composition, and fastener materials cannot be confirmed from the drawing.
Electrical connectors, wiring, driver circuitry, thermal provisions, and venting are not visibly detailed.
The annotated optical and durability performance cannot be verified from this exploded drawing.
